versions.changelog: Update: Sync with latest code from repository

Tencent Meeting Recording Export Tool – Initial release

- Export full meeting transcripts from Tencent Meeting public sharing links
- Supports AI-generated summary, intelligent chapters (with timestamps), key meeting events, and speaker-identified transcription
- Output formats: Markdown and/or original JSON data, with flexible export options
- Uses Playwright (headless Chromium) to retrieve and format meeting data
- Command-line and direct Python usage supported
- Requires meeting to have transcription enabled and uses public (no-login) link
